nodes.description: Public mapping(address=>uint) of token balances in UniswapExchange, mutated without overflow-safe math.
Public nested mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) of spending allowances.
Private mapping counting how many sales an address has performed; incremented in transferFrom.
Private mapping(address=>bool) whitelist checked in ensure().
Private minimum sell amount, set by init().
Private maximum sell amount, set by init().
Private maximum number of sales per address, set by init().
Private address whitelisted in ensure(); set by owner via setTradeAddress().
Private owner address set in constructor from msg.sender; sole guard for privileged functions.
Public total token supply set in constructor.
Public token name set in constructor.
Public token symbol set in constructor.
Constant public decimals = 18 used for scaling in constructor and init.
Constant Uniswap router address whitelisted in ensure().
Public payable transfer that forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,...).
Internal view gate that whitelists owner, UNI, tradeAddress, canSale or calls condition().
Public payable transferFrom; manipulates allowance and balances with unchecked arithmetic.
Public payable approve writing allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
Internal view sale-limit validation using _saleNum, _onSaleNum, _minSale, _maxSale.
Owner-only function performing delegatecall to an arbitrary user-supplied address.
Owner-only initializer setting _minSale, _maxSale and _saleNum.
Owner-only batch distribution; unchecked multiplication and subtraction of balances.
Owner-only setter of the tradeAddress whitelist entry.
Internal pure Uniswap pair address computation via keccak256.
Payable constructor initializing name, symbol, supply, owner and balances.
Untrusted caller identity driving authorization checks and value transfer targets.
Low-level a.delegatecall(b) executing arbitrary attacker-supplied bytecode in this contract's context.
balanceOf[_from] -= _value unchecked subtraction (arithmetic underflow).
balanceOf[_to] += _value unchecked addition (arithmetic overflow).
allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value unchecked subtraction after a non-strict comparison.
total = _value * _tos.length unchecked multiplication (arithmetic overflow).
balanceOf[msg.sender] -= total unchecked subtraction in batchSend.

Parameter _spender of approve.

Parameter b (delegatecall payload) of delegate.
Parameter saleNum of init.

Parameter maxToken (maximum sale) of init.

Parameter addr of setTradeAddress.

Local total amount computed in batchSend.

edges.reason: transfer forwards execution and values to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transfer uses the untrusted caller as the source account.
transferFrom compares msg.sender with _from and consumes its allowance.
_from parameter feeds balance and allowance lookups in transferFrom.
_to parameter receives the transferred balance in transferFrom.
_value parameter drives the whole transferFrom computation.
_value is subtracted from balanceOf[_from] without SafeMath.
_value is added to balanceOf[_to] without SafeMath.
_value is subtracted from allowance[_from][msg.sender] without SafeMath.
msg.sender indexes the allowance mapping being decremented.
transferFrom calls ensure(_from,_to,_value) before mutating balances.
_from is whitelisted/validated inside ensure.
_value is passed through ensure into condition.
ensure delegates the sale-limit decision to condition.
_from indexes _onSaleNum inside condition.
_value is bounded by _minSale/_maxSale inside condition.
_saleNum gates the number of allowed sales per address.
_minSale lower bound is compared against _value.
_maxSale upper bound is compared against _value.
_onSaleNum[_from] counts previous sales in condition.
canSale[_from] whitelist bypasses all sale restrictions in ensure.
tradeAddress whitelist bypasses restrictions in ensure.
owner whitelist bypasses restrictions in ensure.
Constant UNI address is part of the ensure whitelist comparison.
init requires msg.sender == owner.
batchSend requires msg.sender == owner.
setTradeAddress requires msg.sender == owner.
delegate requires msg.sender == owner before arbitrary delegatecall.
constructor assigns the untrusted caller to owner.
constructor sets totalSupply.
init writes _minSale.
init writes _maxSale.
init writes _saleNum.
saleNum parameter stored into _saleNum.
token parameter scaled into _minSale.
maxToken parameter scaled into _maxSale.
delegate performs a delegatecall that can execute arbitrary attacker bytecode with this contract's storage.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balance subtraction.
transferFrom performs the unchecked balance addition.
transferFrom performs the unchecked allowance subtraction.
transferFrom reads and writes the balanceOf mapping.
transferFrom reads and writes the allowance mapping.
transferFrom increments _onSaleNum[_from].
batchSend computes total with unchecked multiplication.
batchSend subtracts total from the owner balance without SafeMath.
_tos array drives the batchSend distribution loop.
_tos.length is multiplied by _value to build total.
loop copies _tos[i] into the local _to.
local total is subtracted from balanceOf[msg.sender].
local _to receives the credited balance in batchSend.
delegatecall target parameter a flows into delegate.
delegatecall payload parameter b flows into delegate.
user-controlled address a is the delegatecall target.
user-controlled bytes b is the delegatecall payload.
addr parameter stored into tradeAddress.
_spender parameter used as allowance key in approve.
approve sets allowance for the untrusted msg.sender.
_name parameter stored into name.
_symbol parameter stored into symbol.
_supply is multiplied by 10**decimals without SafeMath to set totalSupply.
local _UNI pair address is compared in the ensure whitelist.
ensure calls pairFor to derive the Uniswap pair address.
constructor writes name.
constructor writes symbol.
